field.label: Private Key
field.help: The node's private key. Changing it changes the node's identity and IPv6 address.

field.label: Interface Mode
field.help: Choose automatic interface naming, disable the TUN interface, or specify a custom name.

field.help: Interface name to use when Custom is selected.

field.help: Information to publish as a JSON object. Use {} for an empty object. Do not include secrets.
